name: flammability_hotspots
description: Test 7, derived by hand from 6.7: each candidate, in discovery order, merges into the FIRST hotspot in list order with Manhattan distance < radius (h := ((h * w + c) / (w + 1)) with C integer division, weight + 1), else is appended; then hotspots with weight < min weight are removed. Radius 8, min weight 2, candidates (10,10), (12,13), (30,30), (11,10): (10,10,1); distance 5 -> (11,11,2); distance 38 -> new (30,30,1); distance 1 -> ((22 + 11) / 3, (22 + 10) / 3) = (11,10,3); prune -> [(11,10,3)]. The radius is exclusive: (0,0) and (8,0) stay apart with radius 8, (7,0) merges to (3,0,2). First in list order: (0,0), (10,0), then (5,0) with radius 6 (distance 5 to both) merges into (0,0) -> (2,0,2). Through the simulator, EndOfCycle replaces the old list and clears the candidates.
